item.title: 🔵 Your Worker can now have its own cache in front of it
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.
We are launching Workers Cache, a regionally tiered cache that sits directly in front of your Worker entrypoints. Infinitely composable, configured via standard HTTP headers

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 17h ago
